newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer sets new distribution rate.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer sets new distribution rate.

text.p: Oppenheimer Capital L.P. said on Monday that it has declared a distribution of $0.75 per unit payable November 29 to holders of units of limited partnership interest at the close of business October 31.
On an annual basis, the new distribution rate is $3.00 per unit, an increase of 15.4 percent or $0.40 per unit.

Oppenheimer Capital L.P. owns a 67.5 general partnership interest in Oppenheimer Capital, one of the leading independent investment management firms in the United States with total assets under management at Sept. 30 of $44.5 billion.

Joseph M. La Motto, Oppenheimer Capital's chairman and chief executive officer, stated, "The higher distribution rate reflects the continued strong financial results of the operating partnership. With the new distribution rate, the partnership offers investors a current return of 8.9 percent based on the Oct. 18 closing price of $33.875 per unit."
In addition, the partnership said it expects to continue its policy of paying special distributions after its April 30th fiscal year end.
